domAttribute.jsonData: { "faq_list": [ { "question": "What are Twitch Drops?", "answer": "Twitch Drops are rewards granted to you for watching the content and channels you love! Each Drop has a watch time requirement set by the game developer. When you watch a participating channel, your time counts toward earning the Drop and its associated reward. You can check your progress any time by visiting the Drops Inventory page." }, { "question": "How do I claim and receive a Drop?", "answer": "You must watch a participating channel to receive progress towards the Drop. When you watch for the required amount of time, a claim message will appear at the top of the Twitch navigation, where you’ll be directed to the Drops Inventory page to claim your reward. If you miss the claim message, you will still be able to claim the Drop for the duration of the campaign from the Drops Inventory page." }, { "question": "Do I need to watch the same channel the entire time to earn Drops from a campaign?", "answer": "No, you can earn progress towards a drop on any participating channel for a campaign. For example, you can watch for a half hour on one channel, then switch to another channel and continue your progress toward the Drop." }, { "question": "Where can I see my progress towards earning a Drop?", "answer": "You can check your progress against any active Drops campaigns by looking at the Drops Inventory page." }, { "question": "Who Can Earn Twitch Drops?", "answer": "Drop rewards are available to AION 2 Global server players only, so players on the Korea and Taiwan servers aren't eligible. If you're on the Global server and your reward still hasn't arrived after claiming the Drop, reach out to Support." }, { "question": "What if I have another question?", "answer": "More information can be found on Twitch's Drops Help page. For questions about your AION 2 rewards or account, reach out to Support." }, { "question": "How do I link my Twitch Account to my AION 2 Account?", "answer": "Twitch Drops rewards are delivered to the account that your Twitch account is linked to. If you previously linked a different NC account, the reward will be delivered to that NC account rather than your Steam account. \n\nBefore claiming AION 2 Twitch Drops, you must first make sure your Twitch account is correctly linked. Check your account linking status by logging into the official NC website and going to My Page > Manage Login." } ]}
